# REL002 lockstep-version-mismatch

Crates or the wheel whose version differs from the workspace version.

## What it does

Every crate and the wheel are released at one version. The workspace version is
`[workspace.package] version`; a member inheriting it with `version.workspace =
true` is equal by construction, and so is a wheel whose version is dynamic under
the `maturin` backend. A manifest that cannot be parsed is reported Unresolved
with the reason.

## Why it matters

A crate left behind (or ahead) means a published crate set that cannot be installed together.

## Remedy

Run `frob release cut VERSION`, which sets every crate and the wheel to VERSION
in one commit (`frob release bump VERSION` rewrites the versions alone), or make
the named member inherit the workspace version with `version.workspace = true`.

## Examples

### A violating case fires

```rust expect=fire file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

### A conforming case is clean

```rust expect=clean file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

## Examples

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / One crate left at an older version fires #1 (line 11) (fire)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob 0.532.0
crate frob-ack 0.531.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / The wheel left at an older version fires #2 (line 19) (fire)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob inherit
wheel 0.531.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Without a workspace version the straggler is still named #3 (line 27) (fire)

```text
workspace -
crate a 0.2.0
crate b 0.2.0
crate c 0.1.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Every crate at the workspace version is clean #4 (line 36) (clean)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob 0.532.0
crate frob-ack 0.532.0
wheel 0.532.0
```

### REL002 lockstep version mismatch / Inherited versions and a maturin dynamic wheel are clean #5 (line 45) (clean)

```text
workspace 0.532.0
crate frob inherit
crate frob-ack inherit
wheel dynamic
```
